name: vocdoni-internal-oauth
description: Add Google sign-in for @vocdoni.org staff to an existing internal web tool through the central Vocdoni OpenID Connect provider at oauth.vocdoni.org: register the tool as a client, wire the Go kit (vocauth) or the Node/TypeScript kit (@vocdoni/oauth, Express and Fetch-API frameworks), use any OIDC library or oauth2-proxy for other stacks, develop locally against the dev provider, migrate away from a shared password, rotate cookie keys and troubleshoot.
